title: Unit 4 - What are you doing now?

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 1
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

items.question:
Hi, Sandra. Are you going to hockey practice this evening? My brother's taking me, on his way to cricket. Shall we pick you up?
Stefanie
options: Stefanie is offering Sandra a lift to hockey practice.
Stefanie is trying to find out if there is hockey practice today.
Stefanie is asking Sandra if she wants to do cricket instead of hockey.

items.question: The pool temperature is lower this week, as we are repairing the heating.
options: The problem with the pool heating is now fixed.
The swimming pool is not open this week.
The water will not be as warm as usual.

items.question:
Dad, Sam called to ask me to play tennis. I've borrowed your racket – I don't know where mine is. Can you look for it?
Katia
options: Katia wants her dad to play tennis with her.
Katia wants her dad to find her tennis racket.
Katia wants her dad to lend her his tennis racket.

items.question:
Sale starts next Monday.
Large discounts on sports clothes, including 50% off all swimming costumes.
options: You will spend less if you buy sports clothes now.
Some sports clothes will be half the usual price.
Sports clothes in larger sizes will be cheaper.

items.question: Football team: as the weather's good, come to the sports field for practice, this evening only. 8 p.m. as usual. Don't forget your kit!
options: The team should go to a different place today.
The practice will be at a different time today.
The team have to wear a different kit today.

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 1
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

items.question:
From: Hockey club staff
To: All members
Please remember that to park free at the sports centre, you must leave your member's card in your car window.

What do club members have to do?
options: Ask staff at the club about where to park.
Show their member's card to get free parking.
Contact the sports centre about getting a new card.

items.question:
LANG RIVER FISHING CLUB
If you catch more than two large fish (over 25 cm) in one day, you must put them back in the river.
options: You cannot keep more than two big fish each day.
You cannot catch more than two big fish each day.
You can never keep fish that are smaller than 25 cm.

items.question:
Handow Beach
Never surf between red and yellow signs – this area is for swimmers only.

This notice tells people
options: why surfing is dangerous at the beach.
where they cannot go surfing.
who must not use the beach.

items.question:
From: Freya
To: Alicia
I enjoyed being in the school fashion show. Thanks for lending me your pretty red shoes – they were really comfortable.
options: Freya wants some shoes like Alicia's.
Freya is deciding what shoes to wear for a show.
Freya borrowed a pair of shoes from Alicia.

items.question:
Summer cycling kit – all half price
HURRY! Last day of sale Friday 23rd August
options: Get cycling kit cheaper for one day only in August.
Cycling kit prices are low until 23rd August.
On 23rd August, you pay normal prices again for cycling kit.

items.question:
From: Freddie
To: Sam
My brother's driving me to Mandron skateboard park this afternoon. We can pick you up on the way if you want to come.

What is Freddie doing in this message?
options: Offering Sam a lift later today.
Giving Sam advice about activities.
Asking Sam for help with transport.

parts.title: Listening Part 1
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

items.question: How much was Jenny's new tennis racket?
What time does the hockey match start?
What is the boy drinking?
options: A can of lemonade
A juice box
A hot drink in a mug

items.question: Who is the girl's table tennis coach?
options: Blonde hair with glasses
Dark hair without glasses
Dark hair with glasses

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: I love your new tennis shoes, Jenny. Were they expensive?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: No, they weren't. They were £35. My racket was more expensive.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Oh really? How much was that?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: I bought it online for <u>£40</u>. My sister paid £45 for hers.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Excuse me. What time does the hockey match start?

script.speaker: Man
script.text: It starts at <u>half past four</u>.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: What time is it now? Am I late?

script.speaker: Man
script.text: No, it's only ten past four. Go for a walk and come back at twenty past four.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: I'm thirsty after that race.

script.speaker: Simon
script.text: This <u>lemonade</u> is really good. I bought it over there in the café.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Is there any juice?

script.speaker: Simon
script.text: I don't think so, but they've got hot chocolate if you prefer that.

script.speaker: Maisie
script.text: That's my table tennis coach.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Who? Is he that blond man over there with glasses?

script.speaker: Maisie
script.text: No, he's got <u>dark hair and he doesn't wear glasses</u>.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Oh, I can see him now. He's standing over there next to Brendan.

parts.title: Listening Part 1
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

items.question: Where is Jessie playing table tennis?
options: At a house
At a school
At a sports centre

items.question: What does the girls' football team wear?
options: Black shirts, black shorts and white socks
Black shirts, white shorts and black socks
Black shirts, white shorts and white socks

items.question: What time is Henry's skiing lesson?
What is the mother's gym teacher doing this evening?
options: Teaching a gym class
Flying somewhere
Staying in bed

items.question: Where did Lily put the advertisement for her football ticket?
options: Online
On the radio
At her football club

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Where's Jessie, Robert? At the sports centre?

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Well, she's playing table tennis with her friend, Kate, but not at the centre. They went to <u>Kate's place</u> after school.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: To Kate's house, you mean?

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: That's right, and they're going to the sports centre to play volleyball after that.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Does your team wear black shirts, like ours?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: With white numbers, yes. Our team wears nearly the same as yours, but our <u>socks are white</u>, not black.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Oh. So you wear white shorts, too?

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: We do, with a black number at the sides.

script.speaker: Man
script.text: Is your skiing lesson before or after mine this morning, Henry?

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: What time's yours, Dad? I can't remember.

script.speaker: Man
script.text: It's at 8.45.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Oh, well, mine starts half an hour later, at <u>quarter past nine</u>. You'll have to get up before me!

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Why aren't you at your gym class this evening, Mum?

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: Our teacher can't do the class this week.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Is she ill again?

script.speaker: Woman
script.text: No, she's fine now. She's <u>flying to Paris</u> tonight because she's going to visit a friend there tomorrow.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: Lily, hi. Did you sell that football match ticket that you don't want? I just heard someone on the radio asking for tickets.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Oh, I've sold mine. I put <u>a poster up at my football club</u> and someone there wanted it.

script.speaker: Boy
script.text: That's good.

script.speaker: Girl
script.text: Yes, Dad put an advertisement online first, but no one called us about that.

parts.title: Writing Task
parts.instructions: Read the email from your English friend, Ed. Write an email to Ed and answer the questions. Write 25 words or more.
parts.prompt:
From: Ed

We have to wear a school uniform at school and I don't like it. What do you usually wear for school? What are your favourite kinds of clothes? How often do you go clothes shopping?

checklist.band5: All three questions are answered clearly and with relevant detail.
checklist.band3: Two questions answered, or answers lack detail.
checklist.band1: Only one question answered or content is mostly irrelevant.

checklist.band5: The email is well-organised with a greeting, clear answers and a sign-off.
checklist.band3: Some organisation but may lack greeting/sign-off or answers are not clearly separated.
checklist.band1: Very little organisation. Hard to follow.

checklist.band5: Uses a range of everyday vocabulary and grammar accurately. Spelling is mostly correct.
checklist.band3: Uses simple vocabulary and grammar with some errors that don't prevent understanding.
checklist.band1: Very limited vocabulary. Frequent errors make the text difficult to understand.

parts.sampleAnswer:
Hi Ed,
We can wear what we like for school. My favourite clothes are jeans, jumpers and T-shirts. I go clothes shopping about six times a year.
See you soon,
Michele

parts.title: Writing Task
parts.instructions: Read the email from your English friend, Ali. Write an email to Ali and answer the questions. Write 25 words or more.
parts.prompt:
From: Ali

We've got a new sports centre in our town and I play volleyball there. Where's your nearest sports centre? What can you do there? How often do you go there?

checklist.band5: All three questions are answered clearly and with relevant detail.
checklist.band3: Two questions answered, or answers lack detail.
checklist.band1: Only one question answered or content is mostly irrelevant.

checklist.band5: The email is well-organised with a greeting, clear answers and a sign-off.
checklist.band3: Some organisation but may lack greeting/sign-off or answers are not clearly separated.
checklist.band1: Very little organisation. Hard to follow.

checklist.band5: Uses a range of everyday vocabulary and grammar accurately. Spelling is mostly correct.
checklist.band3: Uses simple vocabulary and grammar with some errors that don't prevent understanding.
checklist.band1: Very limited vocabulary. Frequent errors make the text difficult to understand.

parts.sampleAnswer:
Hi, Ali
My nearest sports centre is in my village, next to the park. You can play badminton, squash and volleyball there and it's got a swimming pool. I never go because I don't like sports!
Bye,
